title: News 10.26.2026
content: Broad-developed technology powers an ultra-sensitive blood test for cancer DNA The technology, MAESTRO, is at the heart of Abbott’s new Oncodetect test, which detects extremely low levels of tumor DNA in a patient’s blood sample, helping doctors detect cancer recurrence. By Jessica Colarossi October 26, 2026 Credit: Steph Stevens Viktor Adalsteinsson, senior director of the Gerstner Center, led the development of MAESTRO.
